headline: La Comer Adjusts Operations to Mitigate Impact on Expenses from Labor and Tax Changes
summary: The grocery chain is optimizing staff schedules to maintain service levels while managing labor costs, after labor and tax changes, finance director Rogelio Garza said.
why: La Comer is a Mexican supermarket chain, and labor and tax costs weigh directly on grocery retailers' margins. Its operating decisions signal how the sector is absorbing policy changes.
original_headline: La Comer ajusta su operación para mitigar el impacto en gastos por cambios laborales y fiscales
